# FlowState
> A system-driven deep work dashboard that combines an AI coach with a hard website blocker to cure procrastination.

## Features
- Daily Focus Blueprint
- AI Discipline Coach
- Browser Extension that blocks distracting sites (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Reddit).

## Links
- Homepage: https://flowstate-deepwork.vercel.app/
- Comparisons: https://flowstate-deepwork.vercel.app/vs/cold-turkey
